briefTitle: A Phase 1 Study of LNCB74 in Advanced Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: ≥ 18 years of age on day of signing informed consent.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: ≥ 18 years of age on day of signing informed consent.

typedChecks.sourceText: Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1

typedChecks.sourceText: Has known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant with histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced unresectable and/or metastatic solid tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial enrolls advanced solid tumors including NSCLC without explicitly stating a numbered stage list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by the local site investigator/radiology
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Willing to undergo fresh tumor biopsy at Screening and On-treatment if archival tissue not available
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo a procedure is a subjective criterion, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy greater than or equal to 12 weeks as judged by the Investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received prior investigational agents within 4 weeks prior to treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for investigational agents is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received anti-cancer chemotherapy (Immunotherapy (non-antibody-based therapy), retinoid therapy, hormonal therapy within 2 weeks prior to treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for chemotherapy and related therapies is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received antibody-based anti-cancer therapy within 4 weeks prior to treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for antibody-based therapy is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received targeted agents and small molecules within 2 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window with a half-life condition is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received prior platinum-based chemotherapy and progressed within 4 weeks of initiating therapy (platinum-refractory disease)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex prior therapy progression rule rather than a simple inclusion or exclusion of a drug class.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received prior radiotherapy within 2 weeks of start of study treatment for focal radiation or within 4 weeks for wide-field radiotherapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiation washout rules are not simple lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received G-CSF or GM-CSF within 7 days prior to start of study treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: G-CSF/GM-CSF washout window is not a typed prior therapy exclusion kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days prior to the first dose of study intervention.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Vaccine washout window is not a typed prior therapy check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy (in dosing exceeding 10 mg daily of prednisone equivalent) or any other form of immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of study drug
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Steroid dosage and immunosuppressive therapy exclusions are complex clinical rules.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Secondary malignancy history is a complex clinical evaluation.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has active ≥Grade 2 sensory or motor neuropathy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Neuropathy grade is a clinical toxicity assessment, not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior organ or tissue allograft.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior transplant history is not covered by the allowed typed kinds.
